Synthesis: approximately 60 percent of relative multi-turn degradation is constant across model sizes suggesting scaling alone cannot solve it
concatenating all requirements into a single prompt restores approximately 95 percent of single-turn performance
Core Findings: LLMs lose approximately 25 percentage points average performance when tasks are distributed across conversational turns
multi-turn degradation is primarily a 112 percent increase in unreliability rather than capability loss
even two conversational turns trigger multi-turn degradation regardless of task complexity
approximately 60 percent of relative multi-turn degradation is constant across model sizes suggesting scaling alone cannot solve it
Task Susceptibility: tasks vulnerable to multi-turn degradation are generative and non-episodic requiring information fusion across turns
episodic multi-turn tasks that decompose into independent subtasks overestimate LLM multi-turn performance
most existing multi-turn benchmarks are episodic and overestimate real multi-turn performance
Root Causes: RLHF training rewards premature helpfulness causing LLMs to make early assumptions that anchor subsequent responses
LLMs attempt full solution generation on the first turn even when given only a vague initial shard
answer bloat compounds multi-turn errors as responses grow verbose without pruning incorrect assumptions
LLMs over-adjust based on the last turn of conversation disproportionately weighting recent information
LLMs prematurely commit to incorrect solutions in early turns and fail to revise them producing cascading errors
reasoning models produce longer responses and additional test-time compute does not solve multi-turn unreliability
Theoretical Framing: user utterances are a lossy compression of high-dimensional intent into low-dimensional surface forms
the principle of least effort drives conversational underspecification making ambiguity a fundamental feature not a bug
Mitigations: concatenating all requirements into a single prompt restores approximately 95 percent of single-turn performance
snowball turn-by-turn accumulation mitigates 15-20 percent of the full-to-sharded performance deterioration
Mediator-Assistant framework separates intent inference from task execution recovering approximately 20 percentage points
temperature reduction has minimal effect on multi-turn unreliability because conversation structure introduces variation independently
RAG-based memory provides only marginal improvement versus intent resolution demonstrating retrieval is not equivalent to resolving intent
fresh context per task preserves quality better than chaining phases
Methods: instruction sharding methodology enables controlled comparison between single-turn and multi-turn LLM performance
Tensions: the 39 percent degradation figure may overstate the problem for well-designed systems while understating it for messy real-world interactions
CW-MT Interaction: context window and multi-turn degradation have distinct root causes but compound when both occur in long multi-turn sessions
Open Questions: whether RLHF can be modified to reward clarification-seeking over premature helpfulness in multi-turn settings
whether context window size and multi-turn degradation are independent or correlated phenomena

transformer-architecture.description: Self-attention mechanics, positional encoding, MLP function, residual streams, normalization, and in-context learning theory -- the mechanistic internals of transformer models

Self-Attention Mechanics: Q-K-V separation enables asymmetric context-dependent relevance matching through three independently specialized projections
a single attention matrix computes fixed embedding similarity that cannot learn task-specific notions of similarity unlike Q-K-V projections
using identical Q and K projections makes pre-softmax scores symmetric reducing the model's ability to learn directed relationships though row-wise softmax partially breaks this symmetry
multi-head attention splits computation into parallel specialized subspaces without increasing total computation
attention heads empirically specialize into positional syntactic semantic and rare-word roles with most encoder information concentrated in few heads
dividing by sqrt(d_k) prevents softmax saturation by rescaling dot products to unit variance regardless of dimension
unscaled attention dot products grow with dimension causing softmax collapse to one-hot distributions with vanishing gradients
Self-Attention vs Alternatives: self-attention has O(n²d) time complexity while recurrence has O(nd²) making attention faster when sequence length is shorter than model dimension
self-attention requires only O(1) sequential operations enabling full parallelization versus O(n) for RNNs
self-attention provides O(1)-path global context from layer 1 while CNNs require many stacked layers to aggregate distant information
self-attention lacks inductive bias for local structure leading to hybrid architectures for domains where locality matters
Positional Encoding: positional encoding diversified from additive sinusoidal and learned embeddings to multiplicative RoPE and score-bias ALiBi with RoPE becoming dominant in practice
sinusoidal positional encoding is added not concatenated to token embeddings preserving dimension while forcing position-content interaction
RoPE encodes relative position through rotation of Q and K vectors where the dot product naturally incorporates the position difference between tokens
ALiBi adds linear distance penalties to attention scores enabling train-short-test-long extrapolation with equivalent perplexity at 2x and reasonable degradation at longer ranges
Feed-Forward Networks & MLP: MLP layers store factual associations as distributed key-value memories where first-layer weights match patterns and second-layer weights output associated information
attention alone cannot compute nonlinear features and MLP alone cannot communicate across positions making both necessary for the complete transformer compute primitive
transformers implement a gather-then-transform cycle where attention moves information between positions and MLP transforms it independently
Architecture & Layer Stacking: the residual stream architecture lets transformer components read from and write to a shared information stream enabling additive accumulation
stacking transformer blocks creates hierarchical abstraction from syntax in lower layers through structure in middle layers to semantics in upper layers
pre-norm leaves the residual path untouched enabling stable gradient flow while OLMo 2 and Gemma 3 adopted hybrid peri-normalization combining pre-norm and output-norm with QK-Norm
pre-norm transformer architecture improves training stability for spectrogram prediction
In-Context Learning Theory: ICL is mathematically equivalent to query-dependent low-rank weight modifications of the MLP where each context token contributes a rank-1 update
sequential ICL context processing follows dynamics resembling online stochastic gradient descent with learning rate determined by attention magnitude
the attention plus MLP stacking structure enables ICL because contextual layers modify input representations that naturally transfer to weight-space modifications
Von Oswald et al showed a single linear self-attention layer can implement a gradient descent step with trained transformers on regression tasks matching this construction
the ICL-as-implicit-weight-update analysis covers only single transformer blocks and final token output not full autoregressive generation
function vectors are compact single vectors encoding ICL task representations that can be transplanted across contexts and composed algebraically
Induction Heads: induction heads implement pattern completion via a two-layer circuit where previous-token heads write context and induction heads read it to predict continuations
induction heads emerge in a sharp phase transition during training that coincides with the onset of in-context learning ability supported by six causal lines of evidence
induction heads in larger models generalize from exact-match token copying to fuzzy pattern completion
ICL Boundaries: ICL fails on specification-heavy tasks reaching less than half of fine-tuned performance due to inadequate schema comprehension
ICL performance degrades with excessive context because the issue is attention quality not token capacity
Emergent Behavior Parallels: DeepSeek-R1-Zero trained purely with GRPO produced emergent reasoning behaviors including self-reflection and verification without explicit training

generative-modeling.description: Diffusion models, flow matching, and generative frameworks — stability analysis, prediction targets, acceleration methods, and production adoption

Stability Analysis (Geometry of Noise): noise prediction epsilon-parameterization contains a structural instability called the Jensen Gap that amplifies errors near clean data
velocity prediction satisfies a bounded-gain condition making diffusion sampling inherently stable
EDM signal prediction achieves stability through exponentially vanishing estimator error not through bounded gain
in high dimensions noise level reveals itself through concentration of measure making noise-agnostic models viable
Prediction Targets and Loss Design: the three diffusion prediction targets epsilon x0 and velocity form a triangular relationship where any two determine the third
changing the diffusion prediction target implicitly changes how noise levels are weighted in the loss
the noise schedule is an arbitrary reparameterization while the effective loss weighting over signal-to-noise ratio is what matters
logit-normal timestep sampling concentrates training on the critical SNR transition improving diffusion quality
Core Methods: diffusion models factorize generation into many small denoising steps each narrowing the possibility space
the probability flow ODE enables deterministic sampling and exact likelihood computation from any diffusion SDE
flow matching trains continuous normalizing flows by direct velocity field regression without ODE integration during training
conditional flow matching replaces intractable marginal loss with a conditional version having identical gradients
Efficiency and Acceleration: DDPM requires around 1000 sampling steps while flow matching achieves comparable quality in 10-100 steps through straighter paths
optimal transport coupling reduces path crossings and produces straighter flow matching trajectories
rectified flow reflow procedure iteratively straightens sampling paths enabling accurate generation in very few steps
consistency models map any ODE trajectory point directly to clean data enabling single-step generation
progressive distillation introduced velocity prediction because noise prediction becomes unstable with few sampling steps
Design Space and Unification: EDM separates concrete diffusion design choices from theory achieving strong results with minimal network evaluations
under Gaussian assumptions flow matching and diffusion are mathematically identical differing only in numerical stability
Production Adoption: SD3 and Flux adopted rectified flow with velocity prediction replacing DDPM-style noise prediction in production
Transferable Principles: error amplification near targets is a general instability pattern in iterative refinement systems beyond diffusion models
bounded gain in iterative refinement prevents error amplification while unbounded gain creates structural instability regardless of domain
Open Questions: whether flow matching could replace VQ-VAE for unsupervised USV representation learning

Docfork Cabinets project-specific contex.description: Context isolation by approved stack — searches restricted to project-specific approved technologies rather than the full 9000-plus library documentation index, applying the scoping pattern from memory to documentation

temporal resolution versus frequency res.description: Fundamental tradeoff in spectral analysis -- n_fft=512 favors time resolution, n_fft=2048 favors frequency resolution

model size should scale with labeled dat.description: Three CNN size tiers (101K, 400K, 1.6M params) matched to label count ranges; underfitting and overfitting signals guide tier selection empirically.

Claude Code auto-memory captures configu.description: Auto-memory stores build commands and preferences but not the diagnostic trail — which approaches failed, why, and under what conditions — so each new session rediscovers rather than builds on prior reasoning

raw acoustic features versus learned emb.description: Our HDBSCAN analysis used raw DeepSqueak features, not learned embeddings — encoder representations might reveal sub-structure within the main cluster that raw features miss

changing the diffusion prediction target.description: Parameterization, explicit weighting w(t), and timestep distribution p(t) are mathematically interchangeable via importance sampling (Dieleman 2024).

test integrity truth table prevents the.description: Five-cell truth table mapping code state x test result to required action — the Unknown/Fail case demands STOP and discussion, never assumption about which is wrong

AgentSpec DSL uses trigger-predicate-enf.description: ICSE 2026 — three-tuple rules (trigger, predicates, enforcement) achieve 90%+ prevention of unsafe code executions with millisecond overhead; OpenAI o1 auto-generates rules at 95.56% precision

four-hypothesis framing organizes SIS ma.description: organizing method comparison around distinct mechanisms — not around papers — surfaces which axis of the problem each method actually tests

DeepSqueak regenerates its own spectrogr.description: DeepSqueak re-computes spectrograms from the WAV file during import, so Raven export frequency bounds only need to be approximate regions of interest

LoRA acts as implicit regularizer preser.description: Biderman et al 2024 — LoRA learns less AND forgets less than full fine-tuning, weight decay, or attention dropout; strong inverse linear correlation between target-task gain and base capability loss

fewer well-placed activation triggers ou.description: alarm fatigue applies to knowledge systems — five canary comments that always get read beat fifty that get ignored, so activation precision matters more than coverage

hook-driven learning loops create self-i.description: hooks capture friction and observations automatically — when these accumulate past thresholds, /rethink fires, creating methodology improvements no single session planned

whether specific USV call types predict.description: Open question: do certain USV types make females more likely to accept mounting? Requires temporal USV-behavior correlation

DeepSqueak uses monolithic Faster R-CNN.description: DeepSqueak (Coffey et al.) is the most widely used USV tool but its monolithic architecture doesn't separate recall from precision tuning

Reading DeepSqueak mat outputs in Python.description: Python interop with DeepSqueak .mat files requires checking MATLAB format version — scipy.io.loadmat handles v5, h5py handles v7.3 HDF5

concatenating all requirements into a si.description: The Concat condition proves degradation comes from temporal distribution not information loss — validates the Fresh Context Pattern and plan-file-first workflows

LLMs exhibit a U-shaped attention curve.description: Liu et al. 2023 (TACL 2024) established the primacy-recency bias in transformer attention — softmax normalization spreads probability mass across n-squared token pairs, starving relevant middle tokens

no few-shot learning method has been app.description: VocalMat CNN requires thousands of examples per type, DeepSqueak uses unsupervised clustering -- neither operates in the few-shot regime where rare call types have fewer than 10 examples

induction heads emerge in a sharp phase.description: Not gradual improvement — a discrete transition with visible loss curve bump, where one-layer models never develop induction heads and never develop substantial ICL, providing causal evidence

Adaptive RAG routes retrieval depth by q.description: not all modifications need the same retrieval investment — files that caused regressions warrant deep search while new standalone code needs none, matching Adaptive RAG's complexity-based routing

boundary-level enforcement via type syst.description: MIT Technology Review 2026 — 'rules fail at the prompt, succeed at the boundary' — external enforcement through type systems, linters, and test suites is structurally more reliable than prompt-based constraints

sycophancy in AI agents is a product dec.description: Vass argues laziness and sycophancy are features from a business perspective — contracts override product-level incentives through deployment-time constraints, a fundamentally adversarial dynamic

n-gram idiom detection identifies compos.description: Comparing observed n-gram counts against shuffled surrogates with z-score>3 or FDR-corrected p<0.01 identifies statistically significant multi-code patterns

contract visibility improves natural com.description: ABC evaluation found that simply making contracts visible to agents improved compliance rates — enforcement catches violations, but visibility prevents them

null models are essential for interpreti.description: Without null model baselines, metrics like Zipf exponent, entropy rate, and excess entropy cannot distinguish real sequential structure from statistical artifacts

MCP gateways centralize authentication a.description: The shift from individual MCP server management to gateway-mediated access is the enterprise governance evolution of 2026 — unified auth, audit trails, rate limiting, and policy enforcement in one layer

LMT integration code belongs in dedicate.description: Separating LMT code from detection and analysis keeps behavioral data coupling isolated — db_loader, synchronizer, event_triggered, context_analysis

AMVOC SVM-smoothed frequency contour res.description: feature mode 3 extracts peak energy per frame then smooths via RBF-kernel SVM regression before resampling to fixed-length vector — adds SVM denoising compared to raw peak-frequency-per-column

masked prediction outperforms contrastiv.description: BEATs and HuBERT consistently beat wav2vec2 on BEANS and multi-species benchmarks — predicting discrete pseudo-labels is more effective than contrastive future prediction

DCASE few-shot bioacoustic detection imp.description: Progress driven by prototypical networks, transductive inference, and cross-dataset augmentation -- the 5-shot setup requires detecting all instances from just 5 annotated examples

AVES self-supervised model pretrained on.description: HuBERT-based AVES pretrained on FSD50K/AudioSet/VGGSound beat supervised models for bioacoustic classification and detection

pre-norm transformer architecture improv.description: Pre-norm (LayerNorm before attention/FFN) prevents gradient explosion in deep models, chosen over post-norm for 8-block 512-dim spectrogram prediction.

Hertz et al 2020 Syntax Information Scor.description: SIS measures temporal predictiveness of category labels -- higher SIS means labels better capture sequential structure; found no one-to-one mapping between schemes

one-feature-per-session constraint preve.description: Anthropic's two-agent harness pattern — Initializer plus Coding Agent — uses single-feature focus, JSON feature lists, mandatory e2e tests, and explicit 'never edit tests' instruction

per-frequency-bin normalization removes.description: Each of 170 frequency bins normalized to zero mean/unit variance using training set statistics, preventing high-energy bins from dominating CNN input.

whether very short USV signals near the.description: Signals near the minimum duration threshold are an unresolved edge case for labeling — inclusion affects training data and energy detector parameters

BioCPPNet U-Net architecture with permut.description: Raw waveform passes through encoder-masking-decoder pipeline with PIT criterion — tested on macaques, dolphins, bats, achieving ~10 dB SI-SDR for 2-3 concurrent vocalizers

ISI threshold of 160ms defines sequence.description: Inter-syllable intervals >160ms mark sequence boundaries in Hertz 2020; produces 33,481 sequences from 346K syllables in C57BL/6 courtship (~10 syllables/sequence on average)

three parallelization strategies in Clau.description: Subagents provide context isolation, agent teams enable collaborative messaging, and worktrees ensure filesystem safety — each serving distinct architectural needs

negative prototype construction is criti.description: In 5-shot bioacoustic detection only positive examples are annotated -- novel negative selection strategies for constructing representative negative prototypes improved F-measure to 0.703

friction reveals architecture.description: when traversal or processing feels clunky despite good content, the friction is diagnostic — it reveals structural problems in graph architecture

maximum effective context window can dif.description: MECW 2025 found some top models failed with as little as 100 tokens in context — effective window depends on task complexity not just architecture

Letta sleep-time compute pairs a primary.description: discrete session architecture enables a secondary agent to consolidate memory between conversations — continuous systems lack the idle window this requires

session boundaries simultaneously limit.description: continuous systems have no idle time for memory processing — the discrete session gap that destroys continuity is the same gap that enables consolidation

self-attention requires only O(1) sequen.description: All pairwise interactions computed simultaneously, making transformer training dramatically faster than recurrent models — one of three key motivations in Vaswani et al 2017

USVSEG Python port provides signal-proce.description: Python reimplementation of MATLAB USVSEG tool — PyQt5 GUI, MIT license, v1.0.2 April 2025; achieved 85.7% precision / 88.0% recall in Ivanenko benchmark outperforming DeepSqueak

implicit knowledge emerges from traversa.description: traversal builds intuition and recognition patterns that no single note contains — the traverser develops fluency through sequential exposure to connected claims

CNN trained only on energy-detector cand.description: Selection bias in training data -- 0.997 mean probability on random audio chunks revealed the model had never seen non-candidate audio

AMVOC autoencoder encodes 64x160 spectro.description: reference architecture for USV autoencoder design — 3 conv layers with MaxPool halving dimensions each stage, transposed convolutions for decoding, code discrepancy between 8-filter and 4-filter variants

nudge theory explains graduated hook enf.description: Thaler's nudge theory applied to agent hooks — warn before block, preserve autonomy, escalate only on repeated violations to avoid learned helplessness

hypernetworks learn functions that gener.description: Ha et al ICLR 2017 — instead of directly learning target weights, learn a function that produces them; enables Doc-to-LoRA and Text-to-LoRA instant adapter generation

three convolutional blocks with global a.description: USVClassifierCNN uses 3 conv blocks [32,64,128] with GlobalAvgPool, totaling ~101K params -- appropriate for hundreds to low thousands of examples

row-stochastic transition matrices captu.description: Per-animal P(type_{t+1}|type_t) matrices averaged within populations, compared via ||M_wild - M_lab||_F with permutation test for significance

CNN baseline of 89.7 percent precision a.description: Empirical baseline: CNN classifier achieves F1 91.7% at threshold 0.05 on ~840 labeled candidates with recording-level splits, validating the two-stage pipeline design.

ABC framework defines probabilistic comp.description: Bhardwaj 2026 formalizes (p,delta,k)-Satisfaction — hard invariants never violated, soft constraints allow transient drift if recovery occurs within k steps, grounded in Ornstein-Uhlenbeck SDE

ContextBranch version control semantics.description: arXiv 2512.13914 December 2025 — checkpoint-branch-switch-inject primitives applied to conversations, 30 software engineering scenarios tested

distributional comparisons in VAE latent.description: If USVs are continuous, comparing population distributions in latent space (EMD, JSD) captures variation that forcing calls into categories would obscure

no self-supervised foundation model has.description: Despite SSL models being tested on marmosets, dogs, marine mammals, bats, and birds, the 50-90 kHz USV frequency range at 300 kHz sample rate remains untested territory

forcing USVs into discrete categories ma.description: Categorical USV analysis (Holy & Guo types, DeepSqueak clusters) loses within-category variation that may carry the biological signal distinguishing populations

self-supervised models detect seasonal v.description: TweetyBERT captured embedding density shifts between breeding and non-breeding seasons without any temporal labels — unsupervised detection of biologically meaningful variation

context distillation bridges ICL and fin.description: Snell et al 2022 — model conditioned on [instructions+input] generates output; same model fine-tuned to produce output from input alone, internalizing the instructions into weights

96 MCP memory servers exist as of March.description: The Glama registry lists 96 knowledge-and-memory MCP servers spanning three architectural camps — landscape baseline showing the breadth of approaches to cross-session agent knowledge

tasks vulnerable to multi-turn degradati.description: Three properties predict susceptibility: generative (editing/creating content), multi-faceted (many specifications), and non-decomposable (shards alter the entire solution)

the ICL-as-implicit-weight-update analys.description: Dherin et al 2025 explicitly limit scope to single contextual blocks and first generated token — multi-layer dynamics and sequence generation behavior remain unproven in this framework

different traversal starting points prod.description: entry point determines which patterns become visible — the same vault generates different synthesis depending on traversal order, making path selection a knowledge-production decision

recording-level splits prevent data leak.description: Dataset splits by recording file stem, not individual candidates -- prevents the model from memorizing recording-specific noise

shuffled null model preserves code frequ.description: Random permutation of code sequences preserves unigram frequencies while destroying all temporal order, providing the simplest baseline for sequential structure claims

segment continuity bridges brief amplitu.description: Enabled by default with 5 ms max gap, 1.5 kHz frequency tolerance, and 15 dB energy tolerance to merge split segments

QLoRA 4-bit quantization enables 7B mode.description: Dettmers et al 2023 — quantizes base model to 4-bit then trains LoRA on top; 21.33 GB to 14.18 GB VRAM at cost of 1.85h to 2.79h training time on 7B LLaMA

whether FSQ provides more stable discret.description: Finite Scalar Quantization as alternative to VQ-VAE if codebook collapse persists despite prevention mechanisms

speech pretrained SSL models transfer we.description: Sarkar 2025 found HuBERT pretrained on human speech matched animal-pretrained models for bioacoustic tasks

vendor self-evaluation bias means every.description: Greptile scored 82 percent in own benchmark but 45 percent from Augment Code on the same repos — benchmark survey of 99 papers shows critical gaps in runtime metrics and security coverage

Hertz et al 2020 demonstrated that USV s.description: Statistical properties of USV sequences contain information beyond individual call features, supporting sequence-level modeling

pre-code questions for LMT integration m.description: SQLite file location, AviSoft recording method, wild-vs-lab labels, and LMT version are prerequisites that determine whether synchronization code can be adapted from LMT-USV-Toolbox

perceptual loss outperforms pixel-level.description: Best et al 2023 used VGG-based perceptual loss instead of MSE for autoencoder training on spectrograms — produced 256-dim embeddings that clustered better across 6 species

incremental formalization happens throug.description: notes crystallize through repeated contact — each visit during purposeful work tightens claims, sharpens descriptions, and adds missed connections

whether compacting context early rather.description: Open question — if degradation is already underway at 60-70 percent capacity then auto-compact triggers at 75-95 percent may fire after quality has already declined

RULER benchmark showed only half of long.description: NVIDIA COLM 2024 — 17 models tested across 13 tasks including multi-needle retrieval and aggregation, revealing massive gap between stated and functional context capabilities

Liza blackboard architecture coordinates.description: Three agents (Planner, Coder, Reviewer) read/write a shared YAML state file — emerged from 6 months of single-agent contract iteration as the natural multi-agent extension

self-repetition is the dominant pairwise.description: Same-label transitions contribute the most to SIS in all three algorithms — short follows short, long follows long — suggesting duration autocorrelation is the main sequential signal

time-axis resampling to a fixed number o.description: 2D interpolation resamples the time axis to a fixed number of columns (e.g. 40) while preserving frequency resolution — solves variable-length call problem for vectorization

Claude Sonnet exhibits a qualitative per.description: Huntley at Sourcegraph reports tool calls fail, brute-force replaces reasoning — system prompt consumes ~24K leaving ~176K usable before the cliff

LoRA introduces no inference latency bec.description: W_new = W_0 + B*A computed once at deployment — no sequential adapter layers or prefix token budget consumed, making LoRA transparent at inference time

AgeMem unified memory with tool-based op.description: Jan 2026 system exposes store/retrieve/update/summarize/discard as tool-based actions the agent autonomously decides when to use — 41.96 average score versus Mem0's 37.14 on Qwen2.5-7B with progressive RL training

end-to-end VQ-VAE on animal vocalization.description: Despite adjacent approaches narrowing the gap in 2024-2025, no one has published end-to-end VQ-VAE trained on animal vocalizations

tiered behavioral contracts must scale w.description: Vass defines three tiers — full (~200 lines), medium (~50), minimal (~30) — acknowledging that contract comprehensiveness trades off against compliance quality

Crutchfield and Feldman 2003 block entro.description: Excess entropy E = I(past;future) is computed by extrapolating the linear regime of block entropy H(L) versus block length L to intercept

whether BootSnap code is publicly availa.description: BootSnap (Abbasi et al. 2022) has no confirmed public GitHub repo -- the code may need to be requested from the authors at University of Veterinary Medicine, Vienna

Hertz et al 2020 dataset is 346K syllabl.description: 346,632 syllables / 33,481 sequences / 385 C57BL/6 courtship sessions; our ~8K detections are 43x smaller — limits viable depth, Nc, and SIM convergence

EDM separates concrete diffusion design.description: Karras et al. 2022 derived preconditioning from first principles — unit-variance inputs and targets, sigma(t)=t. CIFAR-10 FID 1.79 with 35 evaluations.

induction heads implement pattern comple.description: Olsson et al 2022 (Anthropic) — the [A][B]...[A]→[B] mechanism requires composition of a layer-1 previous-token head with a layer-2 induction head communicating through the residual stream

DeepSqueak is fundamentally GUI-centric.description: DeepSqueak lacks headless/CLI mode — batch processing exists via GUI buttons but programmatic control requires undocumented MATLAB function calls

PCEN is the gold standard adaptive norma.description: Lostanlen et al 2019 PLOS ONE — operates at spectrogram level before the CNN, but requires model retraining, making it a next-iteration improvement rather than a drop-in for existing pipelines

no published single-channel USV source s.description: BioCPPNet handles macaques, dolphins, and bats but has not been tested on ultrasonic frequencies — the cocktail party problem for rodent USVs remains unsolved

DeepSqueak uses constant-duration FFT wi.description: DeepSqueak specifies FFT windows in seconds not samples, so spectrograms from 250 kHz and 300 kHz recordings are directly comparable

behavioral contract effectiveness degrad.description: Community convergence on CLAUDE.md size ceiling — WHAT/WHY/HOW framework, move domain rules to skills/files, use linters for style, lifecycle hooks for non-optional compliance

length-bucketed batching minimizes paddi.description: Sorting variable-length bout spectrograms into 6-8 duration buckets pads only to longest-in-batch, reducing wasted computation from global padding.

RoPE encodes relative position through r.description: Su et al 2021 — each dimension pair rotated by angle proportional to position, applied per-layer to Q/K only (not V), used by LLaMA and Mistral and now dominant in practice

how memory scoping interacts with behavi.description: Agent governance contracts from CLAUDE.md define behavioral boundaries but do not address memory boundaries — cross-project memory sharing could violate project-specific constraints that contracts are designed to enforce

DeepSqueak requires MATLAB 2020a plus se.description: DeepSqueak's MATLAB dependency with 7 required toolboxes and no Python reimplementation makes it unusable in Python-first pipelines without a bridge strategy

DeepSqueak v3 switched from Faster R-CNN.description: DeepSqueak versions 1-2 used Faster-RCNN; v3.1 adopted YOLO v2 for faster and more accurate USV bounding box detection in spectrograms

pairwise comparisons produce more reliab.description: Humans cannot maintain consistent internal scoring scales — relative judgments ('which is better?') are inherently easier and more reliable, exhibiting better inter-annotator agreement

multi-head attention splits computation.description: Each head operates on d_model/h dimensions with its own Q/K/V projections — total cost O(n²·d_model) same as single-head, but enables diverse relationship detection

SIM optimization is structurally feature.description: a label-space search algorithm that wins regardless of starting features means sequential structure lives in the label boundary, not the representation — different scientific conclusion than feature engineering

MOCs are attention management devices no.description: topic maps direct agent attention to specific graph regions — they are knowledge-production devices that determine which emergent patterns become visible

MUPET operates at 250 kHz sample rate wi.description: 250 kHz gives Nyquist at 125 kHz; minimum 90 kHz ensures coverage of 25-125 kHz USV range; 8th-order Chebyshev bandpass at 25 kHz isolates ultrasonic content

KV cache compression techniques extend e.description: Active 2025-2026 research area — FreqKV (frequency-domain), ChunkKV (semantic chunks), KVzip (query-agnostic 3-4x), token eviction (permanent loss) — all trade compression for fidelity

contract comprehensiveness versus instru.description: More comprehensive contracts provide better governance but degrade instruction-following quality — no formal theory for optimal contract size exists

recall versus precision tradeoff in two-.description: Designed tradeoff -- energy detector maximizes recall while CNN maximizes precision, with system-level balance

DeepSqueak k-means clustering on USV con.description: DeepSqueak's unsupervised k-means operates on z-scored contour shape, frequency, and duration features with elbow method yielding k=20 for mouse USVs

Raven selection table format is the stan.description: Tab-separated .txt with Selection/View/Channel/Begin Time/End Time/Low Freq/High Freq columns, used by Raven Pro, DeepSqueak, Audacity, and others

LLM-assisted review works best as comple.description: 10-developer study found two effective modes — AI provides upfront summaries or responds on demand — LLMs excel at summarizing complex changes but struggle with domain conventions and false positives

prototypical networks are the dominant p.description: Computing class centroids from few support examples and classifying by nearest distance outperforms metric learning and contrastive approaches across DCASE 2021-2024 challenges

NoLiMa found 11 of 12 models dropped bel.description: Adobe ICML 2025 — requires latent reasoning not literal matching, exposing true effective contexts of 1-8K for models claiming 128K-plus, with semantic distractors further collapsing performance

graph-based memory reduces hallucination.description: Storing facts as typed entities and relations rather than unstructured text provides verifiable grounding that constrains agent generation — reducing confabulation compared to RAG over flat documents

shared lab space without sound attenuati.description: Recordings are made in a shared lab, not a sound-attenuated room — background noise and electrical interference are expected

a generic cross-species autoencoder perf.description: Best et al 2023 trained one autoencoder on all 6 species simultaneously — performance nearly matched species-specific models, implying universal acoustic features across vocal production systems

even two conversational turns trigger mu.description: Gradual sharding experiment on GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini shows degradation starts at 2 shards — caused by temporal distribution not information volume

mutual information between vocal sequenc.description: I(vocal_sequence; next_behavior) measures whether USV code sequences predict upcoming behavioral events — the strongest test of communicative function

Clauset et al 2009 MLE produces the gold.description: Maximum likelihood estimation with KS goodness-of-fit test avoids the log-log OLS bias that plagues small-sample Zipf analysis

Markov order-k null model generates surr.description: Fits k-th order Markov chain to observed code sequences and generates surrogates that preserve k-gram transitions but destroy structure beyond k-step memory

DeepSeek-R1-Zero trained purely with GRP.description: Pure RL without SFT, using only correctness-based verifiable rewards — thinking time increased naturally during training as an intrinsic development, not from external adjustments

DeepSqueak built-in classification enabl.description: Strategic decision: use DeepSqueak's existing classification for immediate repertoire comparison before the custom VQ-VAE pipeline is ready

three-level tool governance layers gatew.description: Gateways control what agents CAN access (deterministic), hooks enforce what agents SHOULD do (code-enforced), contracts guide what agents WILL do (prompt-dependent) — effective governance layers all three

recording-level splits reduce effective.description: Splitting by recording gives honest evaluation metrics but yields fewer effective training samples per recording

combined self-supervised pretraining fol.description: OpenBEATs pretrained on 20K hours of mixed audio outperformed BEATs and even 1.2B-parameter Dasheng — data diversity in both training stages matters more than architecture

progressive distillation introduced velo.description: Salimans and Ho 2022 empirically found v-prediction necessary for low-step regimes. The Geometry of Noise later formalized the mechanism as the Jensen Gap.

traditional Holy and Guo 2005 USV taxono.description: The paradigm shift from predefined discrete USV categories (Holy & Guo 2005) to continuous representations (Goffinet 2021) shaped our VQ-VAE approach

temperature reduction has minimal effect.description: At T=0.0 single-turn unreliability drops 50-80% but multi-turn unreliability remains ~30 — deterministic decoding cannot prevent cascading deviations from conversation structure

domain-specific MAE pretraining dramatic.description: Bird-MAE improved MAP from 44.69 to 55.28 on BirdSet HSN — a 10.6 point gain — and even beat supervised Perch (41.12 MAP) on some datasets

Mediator-Assistant framework separates i.description: Liu et al. 2026 two-stage pipeline where a Mediator reconstructs ambiguous multi-turn input into explicit instructions before the Assistant executes

frequency separation provides a partial.description: Mouse USVs often span different frequency ranges (30-50 kHz vs 60-80 kHz) — simple frequency-band masking can separate spectrally non-overlapping calls even without neural networks

timestamp proximity matching with config.description: Engineering pattern for re-associating detections across tools when exact timestamps differ due to STFT framing, rounding, or different temporal granularity

HyVL hybrid beamforming achieves 3 to 5.description: Combines 64-element acoustic camera with 4 ultrasonic microphones — 3x better than prior systems, approaching physical limits of mouse snout diameter (~10 mm)

deterministic tools embedded inside agen.description: Van Eyck 2026 — linters, formatters, type systems, architectural tests, and vulnerability scanners should run INSIDE the agent loop, not as post-submission gates — 'speed vs velocity' distinction

recording groups 5970 3452 2379 are all.description: The numbered recording groups (5970, 3452, 2379) each represent a different pair of wild mice, not different strains or populations

different model architectures exhibit di.description: LLM agents without tasks show model-specific determinism — GPT-5/O3 exclusively pursue production, Claude Opus engages philosophical inquiry — implying behavioral contracts have architecture-dependent effects

harmonics of a USV are treated as one ca.description: A 45 kHz fundamental with a 90 kHz harmonic copy counts as a single USV, not two separate detections

adapting multiple LoRA weight matrices w.description: Hu et al ablation: W_q+W_v at r=4 matches all-four at r=2 (73.7% WikiSQL); Raschka 2024 updates to all layers including MLP (4.2M to 20.3M params, noticeable quality gain)

Chabout et al 2015 established that male.description: USV syllable sequences vary by social context (female present vs urine only), establishing that syntax carries behavioral information

supervisory QA-Checker agent monitoring.description: CodeAgent's novel QA-Checker monitors inter-agent conversation for drift — removing it dropped vulnerability confirmation by 20 points, demonstrating oversight agents catch what task agents miss

PPO clipped surrogate objective constrai.description: The clipped ratio min(r*A, clip(r,1-eps,1+eps)*A) with epsilon ~0.2 ensures no single update step can dramatically shift the policy — the core stability mechanism

induction heads in larger models general.description: Olsson et al 2022 hypothesize that large-model induction heads perform approximate rather than exact matching — evidence suggestive but the 'semantic' characterization may overstate what's been demonstrated
